notes: Every figure was extracted verbatim from the primary 10-K document fetched from SEC EDGAR (CIK 0000320193); the exact document URL is cited per entry. Employees: company-wide full-time equivalent (FTE) count as of each fiscal year-end date, excluding the separately disclosed FTE temporary employees/contractors (that extra figure was only disclosed FY2008-FY2014, e.g. FY2008 also had ~3,100 temporary/contractors). Services: as ORIGINALLY reported in that fiscal year's own 10-K -- FY2013-FY2014 under category 'iTunes, Software and Services', FY2015-FY2025 under 'Services'. Restatement caution for trend charts: with ASC 606 adoption and reclassification of the amortization of the deferred value of certain free services, the FY2019 10-K's comparative table restates FY2018 Services to $39,748M (vs $37,190M as originally reported, used here) and FY2017 to $32,700M (vs $29,980M as originally reported, used here); series is therefore not perfectly comparable across the FY2018/FY2019 boundary on an as-reported basis. Also note FY2017 and FY2023 were 53-week fiscal years. FY2025 data (Services $109,158M; ~166,000 FTEs) verified from the FY2025 10-K filed 2025-10-31, which postdates training data. No values were estimated or interpolated; no nulls needed -- all 18 employee years and all 13 services years were found in the filings.
